title: command palette: one typed query fires the identical GET /api/v1/search request three times
body:
Measured by the PM in the console's network log on 2026-09-02 (showcase @ objectstack `main` a39b02a6b, objectui pin 67dadd602a3a, ~800px console): typing `Dogfood` into the ⌘K palette produced three identical `GET /api/v1/search?q=Dogfood&limit=24&objects=…` requests (request ids 47553.2388 / .2397 / .2409 within ~30 ms), all 200. The palette rendered the two hits correctly.

The objectui#7249 dev could not reproduce the palette under headless `Meta+K` (it never opened, 0 requests — inconclusive, not negative), so this is filed on the PM's own reading rather than re-verified. Likely shape: three consumers (palette list, header search button state, /search page prefetch) each issue the query on the same keystroke instead of sharing one debounced request. Needs a measurement with the palette actually open before a fix.

Filed as a `finding` for triage.
